justification: Warringah DCP 2011 Part G holds ten area-limited sections (G1 Dee Why Town Centre to G10), each with its own 'Applies to Land'. All 969 rows were served to every Warringah house (audit run4: 4 severe). User decision 2026-10-16: withhold all, then key G1 back from the council's own LEP map.

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/hide_unmapped_area_rules.py && python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --council northern_beaches --only warringah_g1_dee_why_town_centre
falsifiable_check.fails_when: hide aborts if the served Part G count is not 969; derive reports no-derivation if the outline is missing; the loader rolls back if its own inside point is not found or 25 Dareen St Beacon Hill resolves inside
falsifiable_check.external_authority: WLEP 2011 Centres Map (Planning Portal Local Provisions layer 437, LAY_CLASS 'Dee Why Town Centre'); DCP p95 'applies to land ... in the B4 Mixed Use Zone ... known as the Dee Why Town Centre'
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Forced: selector expect set to 968 in a dry run -> '[ABORT] northern_beaches/warringah-dcp-2011-full: 969 rows, list says 968' (2026-10-16).
